keyPhrases.text: clogging up Circle in the Square
enervating effect of so aggressively clickbaity and uncurious a production
work I have both loved and loathed
no great proof of the play's contemporary resonance
thinking that maybe Romeo and Juliet is kind of mid after all
indifferent dignity with a heavy glaze of alikeness

reasoning: Scathing review with harsh criticism throughout. Calls the production 'uncurious,' lacking coherence, and suggests it makes Shakespeare's classic seem 'mid.' No meaningful praise offered, only sustained negative commentary on direction, concept, and execution.
